git_rationale.root_cause_commit: Pre-existing tracked file (committed in earlier session before this spec window)
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Sentinel file `.claude/.hook-refactor-allow` was created during a refactor session and never deleted, then auto-committed into the repo. Per pretool-claude-config-guard.py logic (line 176-177), its presence makes the hook exit 0 unconditionally, completely disabling the .claude/hooks/ and .claude/commands/ write guard.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Two-pronged: (1) `git rm` removes the file from index AND working tree, restoring the guard immediately. (2) `.gitignore` entry prevents the same accident from happening again — local users can still touch the sentinel for opt-in refactor sessions, but git will refuse to track it.
